title: astragalus globiflorus var. andalanicus
intro: Astragalus globiflorus var. andalanicus, commonly known as Andalusian milk-vetch, is a plant species within the pea family Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including immunomodulatory, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which may help to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus globiflorus var. andalanicus include its ability to modulate the immune response, exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, and protect against cellular damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
